jobs.description:
The opportunity
In this position you will work in the Product Management organization, you will be supporting the product owners in the work define the feature structure, product structure and setup that translate to the full business cycle of HVDC projects. You will be central and work in a very cross-functional environment with explaining and translating the in-house domain knowledge of the colleagues into the portfolios of PLM structures that will enable a good engineer to order business building on the proper product governance with full life cycle view. You will be part of a highly skilled and diversified team, working globally and in close cooperation with many functions of the business, including Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Service and R&D.
How you´ll make an impact 
Collaborate with Product Owners to define and implement feature sets and product structures in Teamcenter PLM, ensuring alignment with business needs and strategies. Support modular portfolio development using classification, variant management, and BOM to enable reuse, automation, and efficient change management, freeing up engineering time for innovation and customer-focused work.
Analyze PLM-related business needs and workflows with stakeholders, identifying gaps and opportunities to accelerate adoption across the HVDC business.
Co-develop strategies with cross-functional teams to optimize PLM usage and provide input to improve system structure and functionality.
Serve as a PLM subject matter expert, supporting training and onboarding to ensure effective system usage and knowledge transfer.
Maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders on implementation progress, proactively escalating issues to ensure timely resolution.
Uphold Hitachi Energy’s values of safety and integrity, demonstrating accountability and fostering a collaborative, respectful work environment.

Your background
We are looking for an engaged, structured, persistent, well-organized, and driven person who is a true team player.
You should have professional engineering competence and a Bachelor’s or MSc. degree in Electric Power Engineering or similar.
You can make the complex simple and show creativity in your approach to problem solving.
You are ready to work in an international and multicultural work environment.
You have worked with High Voltage Equipment or have experience with performing studies for rating of high voltage equipment.
Previous work experience in related area

jobs.occupation: Product Development Senior Engineer – Situational Safety
jobs.description:
Autoliv is the worldwide leader in automotive safety systems. We develop, manufacture and market protective solutions such as airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels for all major automotive manufacturers worldwide, along with advanced safety solutions for new mobility. In 2025, our products helped save approximately 40,000 lives and prevented around 600,000 serious injuries.
We are now looking for an experienced Product Development Senior Engineer to lead the development and execution of safety strategies for next-generation interior safety technologies. In this role, you will drive safety activities from concept through production release, working across engineering disciplines to deliver innovative solutions that help protect vehicle occupants worldwide. 
Role and Responsibilities

Define safety goals, hazard analyses, misuse scenarios, and mitigation strategies.

Lead the development and maintenance of safety cases, including claims, arguments, and supporting evidence.

Drive system architecture and safety decomposition for interior safety functions.

Establish safety milestones, release gates, and acceptance criteria.

Partner with Human Body Modeling & Simulation teams to translate insights into safety solutions.

Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, validation, human factors, and systems engineering.

Manage safety risks, escalations, audits, and customer assessments.

Align global requirements across Europe, North America, China, and Japan.

Support customer reviews and promote innovative interior safety technologies.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor's or master’s degree in engineering or a related field.

10+ years of experience in automotive safety, systems engineering, electronics, or mechatronics.

Strong knowledge of vehicle passive safety regulations and industry standards, including ISO 26262 and NCAP.

Deep understanding of occupant protection, safety mechanisms, and system-level design.

Proven track record of delivering safety cases and leading release governance in production programs.

Ability to actively contribute to and lead technical workshops and decision-making forums.

Experience leading cross-functional teams in a global engineering environment.

Strong documentation and presentation skills.

Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Who Are You?
You are a strategic leader with strong technical expertise and the ability to build alignment across teams and stakeholders. 
You bring:

Strong leadership and coordination capabilities.

Sound judgment and a high sense of ownership.

Excellent relationship-building and collaboration skills.

A strategic and results-oriented mindset.

Strong negotiation and influencing capabilities.

The ability to prioritize effectively and manage competing demands.

High emotional intelligence and the ability to handle conflict constructively. 

Why Autoliv?
At Autoliv, our purpose is simple: Saving More Lives. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to influence the next generation of safety innovations while working alongside some of the industry's most talented experts. Together, we develop technologies that make a real difference for people around the world. 
We would love to hear more about your experience, ambitions, and what inspires you. Let's start the conversation. 
Your Application
Does this sound like the opportunity you’ve been waiting for? Please apply and feel free to contact us if you have any questions. 
Practical information

Place of Work: Vårgårda (Hybrid)

Scope: Full-time

Employment type: Permanent

Start date: According to agreement

 More lives saved – more life lived!

The opportunity
For this position, we are looking for a collaborative, teamwork-oriented manager with a strong interest in cybersecurity and a willingness to share experience and guidance. We would welcome applications from experienced professionals who are keen to take their careers to the next level. To excel in this position, you will need to understand the Cybersecurity trends and regulatory challenges and work proactively to be one step ahead.
At HVDC our Cybersecurity function is split into two teams. You will be heading the Engineering part of the Cybersecurity function with our Project Cybersecurity Leads, Engineers and Risk Assessment Engineers. They are deeply involved in project execution, tendering and other various development activities.  Your task is to support, guide, strengthen and empower the team and you will work with other managers across HVDC to ensure the right and relevant tasks and Divisions of Work for the team
Your Responsibilities 
Support the team in their day-to-day activities.
Ensure relevant involvement in all projects at HVDC (Customer and R&D).
Ensure the team has all the tools and applications needed to support the tasks.
Participating in Project Reviews were necessary.
As Cybersecurity Engineering manager you will be able to answer most questions regarding Technology, best-practice, Laws, Standards and Directives.
For ongoing tenders, you will be involved in contractual and legal discussions for cybersecurity related questions together with our contract managers and legal specialists and counsels.

Your background

Knowledge of one or more critical infrastructure regulations such as NIS/NIS2, NERC-CIP.

jobs.occupation: Senior Maintenance Technician – Mechanical & Cooling Systems
jobs.description:
Own thermal stability and mechanical reliability in a scaling deep-tech factoryOwn Thermal Stability and Mechanical Reliability
At Smart High Tech, we are industrialising advanced graphene-based materials that enable next-generation AI systems, electronics and data centres.
As we scale production, thermal performance and equipment reliability become critical for quality, uptime and efficiency.
We are now looking for a Senior Maintenance Technician – Mechanical & Cooling Systems who will take ownership of this important area and help ensure stable, reliable and scalable production.
Your Mission
You will be the technical expert for mechanical systems and cooling infrastructure, ensuring high equipment availability, efficient operation and long-term reliability.
Your work directly impacts production stability, energy efficiency and product quality.
What You Will DoMaintenance & Reliability
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on mechanical equipment, furnaces and cooling systems.

Troubleshoot hydraulic, pneumatic and thermal systems.

Lead fault diagnosis related to cooling, temperature control and process stability.

Monitor temperature, pressure and flow systems.

Prevent and manage risks related to overheating, leakage and reduced cooling performance.

Maintain technical documentation and maintenance records.

Continuous Improvement
Drive root cause analysis and long-term corrective actions.

Apply preventive and predictive maintenance methods.

Improve equipment reliability, uptime and energy efficiency.

Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions.

Support and mentor colleagues within the maintenance organisation.

Equipment & Industrialisation
Participate in the installation and commissioning of new production equipment.

Support FAT and SAT activities.

Validate cooling systems, thermal processes and mechanical functionality.

Ensure systems are operational before production start-up.

Key Interfaces
You will work closely with:

Facility & Maintenance Manager

Electrical & Automation Maintenance

Production & Engineering

External suppliers and equipment vendors

Who You Are
You are a hands-on technical specialist with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for operational reliability.
Required Qualifications
Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Technology or similar.

F-Gas certification or equivalent refrigeration qualification.

Strong knowledge of hydraulics, pneumatics and cooling systems.

Minimum 5 years of industrial maintenance experience.

Experience with thermal processes and industrial cooling equipment.

Knowledge of CMMS systems and structured maintenance practices.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Meritorious
Experience with reliability-centred or predictive maintenance.

Experience from semiconductor, electronics, advanced materials or process industries.

Knowledge of FAT, SAT and equipment commissioning.

Training in LOTO, pressurised systems and industrial safety standards.

Swedish language skills.

Why Join Smart High Tech?
This is a role for someone who wants technical ownership in a high-performance manufacturing environment.
You will:

Own systems that directly impact product quality and production stability.

Work with advanced thermal and mechanical technologies.

Help scale a deep-tech factory from development to global production.

Influence uptime, efficiency and long-term operational performance.

Join a company solving real challenges in AI infrastructure and advanced electronics.

What Success Looks Like
Within 12 months, you have:

Improved cooling system reliability and production uptime.

Reduced equipment failures and unplanned downtime.

Increased energy efficiency and equipment lifetime.

Successfully supported commissioning of new production systems.

Do you want to help develop the next generation of connected products and digital platforms? Sigma Embedded Engineering is now looking for experienced Android Platform Engineers to join us in creating smart, connected, and sustainable solutions together with our clients.

About the role
As an Android Platform Engineer, you will work closely with our clients to develop and adapt Android at the system level. You will be involved end-to-end – from architecture and design to implementation and optimization of advanced embedded solutions.
You will work in technology-intensive projects where quality, performance, and scalability are key. Assignments range from infotainment systems and automotive solutions to industrial applications and IoT.

Your responsibilities

Customize and develop the Android platform (AOSP)

Work with HAL, Linux kernel, and system integration

Drive architecture and design decisions together with team and client

Troubleshoot and optimize performance across the full stack

Ensure high quality through testing and code reviews

Collaborate in cross-functional teams in agile environments

We believe you have

At least three years of experience in Android platform development (AOSP)

Strong skills in C/C++ and/or Java/Kotlin

Experience with Linux and embedded development

Knowledge of system architecture and software design

Experience with tools such as Git, Gerrit, and CI/CD

Fluency in English (Swedish is a plus)

Meritorious experience

Experience from automotive or safety-critical systems

Knowledge of BSP, drivers, or kernel development

Experience with performance analysis and optimization

Experience with cloud or IoT integration

Preferred additional skills, personal traits and experience
Curious and driven by technology, you are eager to learn and continuously grow within Android and embedded systems. You are a collaborative and communicative team player who takes ownership, works proactively, and builds strong relationships with colleagues and clients.

We offer
At Sigma Embedded Engineering, we believe in you and that together we can create the most exciting opportunities by building the workplace and environment we want to work in. Together, we also find assignments where you thrive and grow. We have assignments in everything from self-driving cars (ADAS), application development, Medtech, Active Safety, IoT, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, 5G, and algorithm development.

Who are we? We love doing things together and strive for a good balance between work and leisure. This could be after-work hangouts, events, sports activities, ski trips, or inspirational talks. We've been on many fun trips together, which have been fantastic, and something we want to continue doing.
Skills development has always been important to us, and in addition to growth opportunities within your consulting assignments and various technical trainings, we also have internal programs for personal development.

We are part of the Sigma Group As part of the Sigma Group, we offer the best of both worlds: stability and entrepreneurial spirit. Sigma consists of several companies within different technical competence areas and currently has over 5,000 employees and operations in many countries. This makes us Sweden’s largest privately-owned consulting group.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking a Senior Oracle PL/SQL Developer for a long-term consulting assignment within a complex, business-critical IT environment. The consultant will join an experienced team responsible for the development and maintenance of databases and backend solutions.
This is a hands-on development role with a strong focus on Oracle PL/SQL, database-centric business logic, and transaction-intensive systems. The environment handles large data volumes, parallel processes, and critical transaction flows, with demanding requirements for stability, performance, and availability. A significant portion of the business logic is implemented directly in the database through SQL and stored procedures. Microservices developed in Java and .NET operate above the database layer and communicate with different business functions and external systems.
The position is specifically focused on Oracle PL/SQL development and business logic. It is not a traditional database administrator role and does not focus on Data Warehousing or Business Intelligence.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, and enhance database functionality and business logic using Oracle PL/SQL and SQL.
Design and maintain stored procedures and other database-centric application components.
Troubleshoot database code and resolve issues in complex, transaction-intensive backend systems.
Analyze and optimize database performance across large-scale Oracle environments.
Work with high-volume data processing, parallel processes, and critical transaction flows.
Develop and maintain integrations and data flows between databases, microservices, external partners, and connected systems.
Collaborate closely with senior developers and architects on technical solutions, system enhancements, and improvements to existing platforms.
Understand complex business processes and translate functional requirements into reliable database-level implementations.
Contribute ideas, technical improvements, and knowledge sharing within a senior, international engineering team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Database platform: Extensive, current hands-on experience with Oracle Database and PL/SQL development.
Database programming: Advanced SQL skills, including stored procedures and database-centric programming.
Performance: Experience troubleshooting and optimizing code in large database environments with stringent performance and availability requirements.
Backend architecture: Experience working with complex, transaction-intensive backend systems and high-volume data processing.
Microservices: Understanding of microservices architecture and backend services developed with Java or .NET is advantageous.
Integrations: Experience implementing data flows and integrations with external partners and systems is advantageous.
Business systems: Experience with billing platforms, CRM solutions, or other business-critical transaction systems is beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience
The successful consultant will have substantial and recent practical experience in Oracle PL/SQL development, together with a strong understanding of SQL, stored procedures, business logic, and transaction flows. Experience diagnosing technical issues, improving performance, and solving problems in large Oracle environments is required. The role also requires the ability to work independently, take initiative, and quickly understand complex technical environments and interconnected business systems.
Previous experience in banking, financial services, energy, or another transaction-intensive industry is advantageous. The consultant should be comfortable collaborating with experienced developers and architects while contributing to technical discussions and continuous system improvement. Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.

jobs.occupation: Client Service Associate  Build a Long-Term Career in Finance (London)
jobs.description:
Are you a Dutch speaker looking for an opportunity to develop professionally, learn new skills and build a long-term career within the financial services industry?
Our client, a leading international investment management company, is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Dutch Client Service Associate to join their growing team.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working behind the scenes, supporting clients and business operations, and is eager to grow within an international organisation. No finance background is required – what matters most is your motivation, willingness to learn and ambition to develop.
The Role
As a Client Service Associate, you will play an important role in supporting the company's daily operations and ensuring a high level of service for its Dutch-speaking clients.
This is primarily a back-office and administrative role, involving collaboration with different teams and financial institutions across Europe.
Your responsibilities will include:
Handling administrative and operational tasks in collaboration with leading banks and financial institutions.
Supporting internal teams with client-related inquiries and daily operations.
Preparing reports and maintaining accurate client information.
Working closely with colleagues across different departments and European markets.
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and contribute new ideas.
Gradually taking on additional responsibilities as you develop within the role.

Career Development
What makes this opportunity particularly interesting is the potential for long-term career growth.
Our client believes in developing talent from within and offers comprehensive training, ongoing support and opportunities to explore different career paths across the business.
You will be encouraged to take initiative, develop new skills and take on greater responsibilities as you progress. Whether your future interests lie in operations, management, analytics or other areas of the business, there are opportunities to shape your own career path.
Our client wants you to grow with the company and chart a course for a rewarding, long-term career.
Your Profile
We are looking for someone who is motivated, organised and genuinely interested in the position and the opportunity it offers.
To be successful in this role, you should have:
Native or fluent Dutch and good English skills, both written and spoken.
A university degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Strong communication and organisational skills.
A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to work well within a team.
A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop.
An interest in building a long-term career within an international business environment.

A background in finance, economics or business is an advantage but not a requirement.
The Offer
Full-time, permanent position.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development.
A collaborative and international working environment.
Excellent opportunities for internal career progression.
The chance to build a rewarding, long-term career within a growing international organisation.

Location: London, United Kingdom (office-based).
Interested?
If you are a Dutch speaker looking for more than just your next job, and are excited about the opportunity to learn, develop and grow within an international company, we would love to hear from you!
Apply today and take the next step towards building your future career.

Nordic Investin is recruiting an ESG and Sustainability Controller on behalf of one of our partner companies. You see finance as both a decision and control function, combining accuracy with the curiosity to turn numbers into action.
The partner is strengthening its capability in auditable sustainability performance connected to financial control. You will connect ESG data, CSRD and controls while ensuring that reconciliations and KPI governance receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.
Finance values dependable reporting, strong controls and constructive partnership. Success means better decisions and trusted information.
How you will work
You will work with finance colleagues, operational leaders and system owners. The partner values early escalation, transparent assumptions and lasting improvements.
This role calls for subject-matter depth and practical ownership. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.
What you will do
Own the practical direction for auditable sustainability performance connected to financial control.
Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for ESG data and CSRD.
Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around controls.
Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting reconciliations.
Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve KPI governance.
Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through assurance.
What you will bring
Relevant experience delivering auditable sustainability performance connected to financial control in a demanding environment.
Strong working knowledge of ESG data and CSRD.
Practical experience applying controls and reconciliations.
Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving KPI governance.
Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

jobs.occupation: Client Service Associate  Build a Long-Term Career in Finance (London)
jobs.description:
Are you a Swedish speaker looking for an opportunity to develop professionally, learn new skills and build a long-term career within the financial services industry?
Our client, a leading international investment management company, is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Swedish Client Service Associate to join their growing team.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working behind the scenes, supporting clients and business operations, and is eager to grow within an international organisation. No finance background is required – what matters most is your motivation, willingness to learn and ambition to develop.
The Role
As a Client Service Associate, you will play an important role in supporting the company's daily operations and ensuring a high level of service for its Swedish-speaking clients.
This is primarily a back-office and administrative role, involving collaboration with different teams and financial institutions across Europe.
Your responsibilities will include:
Handling administrative and operational tasks in collaboration with leading banks and financial institutions.
Supporting internal teams with client-related inquiries and daily operations.
Preparing reports and maintaining accurate client information.
Working closely with colleagues across different departments and European markets.
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and contribute new ideas.
Gradually taking on additional responsibilities as you develop within the role.

Career Development
What makes this opportunity particularly interesting is the potential for long-term career growth.
Our client believes in developing talent from within and offers comprehensive training, ongoing support and opportunities to explore different career paths across the business.
You will be encouraged to take initiative, develop new skills and take on greater responsibilities as you progress. Whether your future interests lie in operations, management, analytics or other areas of the business, there are opportunities to shape your own career path.
Our client wants you to grow with the company and chart a course for a rewarding, long-term career.
Your Profile
We are looking for someone who is motivated, organised and genuinely interested in the position and the opportunity it offers.
To be successful in this role, you should have:
Native or fluent Swedish and good English skills, both written and spoken.
A university degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Strong communication and organisational skills.
A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to work well within a team.
A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop.
An interest in building a long-term career within an international business environment.

A background in finance, economics or business is an advantage but not a requirement.
The Offer
Full-time, permanent position.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development.
A collaborative and international working environment.
Excellent opportunities for internal career progression.
The chance to build a rewarding, long-term career within a growing international organisation.

Location: London, United Kingdom (office-based).
Interested?
If you are a Swedish speaker looking for more than just your next job, and are excited about the opportunity to learn, develop and grow within an international company, we would love to hear from you!
Apply today and take the next step towards building your future career.
